chapter_title: Concerning the Nourishment of the Person, for ther
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:**

There exists [GAP-1] continually within the external mind of the person [GAP-2] — within it are two hundred and fifty thousand confirmations of order impressed upon the understanding [GAP-3]. There are another two hundred and fifty thousand dominant principles governing the will and thought [GAP-4]. These are purified from falsity and cleansed from evil and so enter into interior states [GAP-5] — by means of divine influx perceived inwardly, by means of divine truth received, and by the [GAP-6] — stilled into peace with the cessation of the proprium's activity at the time when the will [GAP-7] of the Divine Love Itself.

*Note on structure:* The two equal multitudes — seals and rulers — correspond to the twofold constitution of the regenerating mind: confirmations of divine order on the intellectual side, and governing affections or dominant principles on the volitional side. Their cleansing describes the progressive removal of what is of the proprium so that divine influx through truth and love may flow into the interiors without obstruction. The "silence" is the state in which self-derived willing and thinking cease, and the person's will is conjoined with the Divine Good of the Father.

---

**¶2:**

Also, the twelve [GAP-8] dominant falsities from evil that belong to spiritual darkness shall be cast out from the interiors of the mind into states of aimless exteriorization and successive displacement through outermost natural states [GAP-9]. Some of them [GAP-10: — are dissipated through] this passage through successive external states, and others among them shall be drawn back inward to be confronted again.

*Note:* The "twelve rulers of Darkness" correspond to the complete system of governing falsities from evil — all the ruling persuasions of the proprium arranged in their false order, opposite to the twelve genuine goods and truths of the church. Their being "swept outside" is the expulsion of these falsities into the exteriors during regeneration. That some perish through transmigration while others are "brought back" reflects how certain deeply-rooted falsities must be encountered repeatedly in successive states before they can be wholly separated from the person, while lighter falsities dissipate of themselves once removed from interior conjunction with the will.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: exists [and is given] daily to the body of the person [of light] there are two hundred and fifty thousand seals in it [of the nous, and] there are another two hundred and fifty thousand rulers [of the heart, and] they are cleansed and purified and enter [into the light] by the voice, by the word, and by the [thought. They are made] quiet with the silence at the time when his heart [is at rest in the love] of God the Father.

Also, the twelve [signs of the zodiac and the] rulers that belong to the Darkness shall be swept out outside in wandering and in transmigration [through many forms, and] some of them [shall perish through] this transmigration, and others among them shall be brought back.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates a divine provision that flows continually into the external mind; "and is given" expresses this influx in the Kephalaia's natural register, describing what exists and is bestowed daily upon the body.

"Person of light" is a standard Manichaean Coptic expression designating the elect or the soul bearing the divine element; the spiritual reading's "external mind" presupposes a person possessing the light-nature within the body.

The spiritual reading identifies the seals as confirmations impressed upon the understanding; in the Kephalaia's vocabulary, "nous" is the standard term for the intellectual faculty, and the conjunction bridges to the parallel enumeration of rulers.

The spiritual reading identifies the rulers as dominant principles governing the will; in the Kephalaia "heart" corresponds to the will, forming a parallel pair with "nous" for the intellectual side, and the conjunction transitions to the cleansing description.

The spiritual reading says they enter "into interior states"; in Manichaean teaching, purified elements entering "into the light" is the standard expression for passage from exterior/material states to interior/divine ones.

Voice, word, and thought form a recognized Manichaean triad (the Great Call, the Answer, and the Thought); the spiritual reading then indicates a transition to being "stilled into peace," which in the Kephalaia's register becomes "they are made quiet."

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading states the will is conjoined with the Divine Good/Love of the Father; "is at rest in the love" expresses this conjunction in the Kephalaia's register, consistent with the preceding theme of silence and cessation of the proprium.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmology the twelve zodiacal signs are the stations imprisoning the archons of darkness; the Kephalaia regularly pairs the twelve signs with their dark rulers, and the spiritual reading's "complete system of governing falsities" corresponds to this zodiacal arrangement.

The spiritual reading describes passage "through outermost natural states"; in the Kephalaia's vocabulary, transmigration proceeds "through many forms" (material incarnations), and the conjunction bridges to the differentiation of fates among the expelled rulers.

The spiritual reading says these are "dissipated through" the transmigration; in the Kephalaia's register, "shall perish through" expresses the permanent dissolution of lighter falsities that do not survive passage through outermost external states.
